question: Do the seven public systems still recorded with no admin entry have an admin screen in their source at all?
why_this_angle: 0022 measured against the live origin: admin-entry-probe.mjs fetches candidate addresses and reads the JS bundles for a nav link, and every candidate it tries is a variation on the word admin. A console under any other name is invisible to it. This run read the source trees instead.

source_scan.method: recursive file listing + content scan for (is_admin|isAdmin|role===admin|/admin|ניהול|adminOnly|service_role) and for route tables, excluding node_modules/dist/.next/build/.vercel
source_scan.note: apps/** is gitignored, so ripgrep reports no matches for text that is present; this scan used the filesystem directly.

results.hits_are: two comments about schema/service_role, not a screen
a comment about layer management inside the editor

results.verdict: HAS a management surface — sites/36-nadlan-pro/tivuch/app.html, 88,112 b, office CRM with a role ladder owner/manager/agent at app.html:484 driving np_* RPCs under RLS

live_probe.method: HTTP without auto-redirect, then with; more30.com only (NetFree blocks *.vercel.app from this machine)

results.is: the reason a suffix probe misses it

anonymous_at_tivuch_app.renders: פתיחת משרד — the office-opening form (name, licence number, city, phone, email) with the login pill in the corner
anonymous_at_tivuch_app.not_claimed: whether submitting that form as an anonymous visitor is refused was NOT measured here and is not asserted
